3D Animator — Riyanjaly & Ansh Media (Remote)
We are seeking a skilled 3D Animator who is proficient in Blender/Maya for animation and Premiere Pro for editing and sound. These two tools are essential for the role. We use Roblox Studio in our pipeline; prior experience in Roblox Studio is not required.
Responsibilities
- Animate characters and scenes using Blender.
- Edit sequences, including basic sound design, in Premiere Pro.
- After onboarding, adapt your animations for use in Roblox Studio.
- Collaborate with the team to meet deadlines and implement feedback.
Requirements
- Proficiency in Blender/Maya for character animation.
- Experience using Premiere Pro for editing and audio.
- Strong grasp of animation principles (timing, weight, posing).
- Open to learning and integrating Roblox Studio into your workflow post-hire.
- Good communication and collaboration skills.
Nice-to-Have
- Familiarity with any game engine or other animation pipelines.
Education: Bachelor's (Required)
Experience: 3D animation: 1 year (Required), Adobe Premiere: 1 year (Required), Maya: 2 years, Blender (3D software): 2 years (Required)
Language: Hindi (Required), English (Required)
